owner_instruction: Continue prior v14 research safely; no new BLS request, resource-boundary adoption, Score/public/Production activation.

proposed_diagnostic_layers.name: reconcile_retained_evidence
proposed_diagnostic_layers.rule: Only v9-v14 commit records, original parser, sanitized issue audit and branch backups; no BLS data calls.

proposed_diagnostic_layers.name: independent_first_release_vintage
proposed_diagnostic_layers.rule: Require explicit BLS first-edition provenance/correction handling. A URL, HTTP Last-Modified, file creation timestamp or unverified PDF metadata alone cannot establish unchanged first-release edition.

proposed_diagnostic_layers.name: page_count_branch_and_resource_security
proposed_diagnostic_layers.rule: Future owner-approved one-use bounded PDF structural request only if unavoidable; sanitized branch statuses below_minimum/above_existing_cap/within_existing_cap/parser_error, never exact count, text or observations. HEAD alone does not prove page count. Do not increase 200 automatically.

proposed_diagnostic_layers.name: page_layout_and_series_schema
proposed_diagnostic_layers.rule: Only after D1+D2 approvals: determine unique governing Table 9 column roles, exact direct commodity code/row label, April 2026 period and index-level (not percent-change) cell; prohibit domestic/extraction/pipeline/stage substitute.

proposed_diagnostic_layers.name: historical_basis_comparability
proposed_diagnostic_layers.rule: Compare original 2013 and original-release 2026 bases, reference periods and release-vintage corrections. No value reads until separate permission.

proposed_diagnostic_layers.name: public_redistribution_rights
proposed_diagnostic_layers.rule: Any source feasibility does not authorize public transformed/source-derived Score values; legal/licensing determination separate.

proposed_diagnostic_layers.name: Score_integration
proposed_diagnostic_layers.rule: No z-score, contribution, weekly input, research ledger mutation, public artifacts or Production changes under this methodology packet.

below_minimum.meaning: At least one required page absent; stop without fallback.

above_existing_cap.meaning: Above the frozen 200-page cap; stop. Further page limit needs independent security and methodology.

within_existing_cap.meaning: Count gate only passed; no Table 9, WPU0561, vintage or rights proof.

parser_error.meaning: Parser unable to establish count safely; stop.

not_observed.meaning: Actual v13 branch still unknown; no new query may be made under consumed authorization.

A.name: freeze_original_fixed_resource_infeasibility
A.methodology: Do not use WPU0561 historical-vintage index-level pair in Score v2.1F under original selected 2026 XLSX.

B.name: design_a_new_source_boundary_and_future_oneoff_preflight
B.methodology: Keep WPU0561 as a research-only candidate. Define source-first-edition evidence, count semantics, cgroup/parser budget, exact row/column/index basis, and a new owner-reviewed one-use receipt/dispatch before a future request.

C.name: continue_fail_closed_hold
C.methodology: No source/score change until evidence and rights are resolved.

recommendation_scope: Nonbinding design recommendation; do not declare owner approval or automatically exclude an existing live Score component.

backups.restoration: Reviewed corrective PR only; preserve all unrelated main commits. Never force-push or remove consumed Git tag.
